column1: # Character select: what each fighter looks like in the default costume. Written 2026-11-27 from the Nekropolis
# character viewer (front, feet and back of each model; Kratos from his select portrait). <name as said><TAB><text>

column2: A tall, heavily muscled Tarkatan with yellow-brown skin, a bald head and a wide mouth of jagged teeth. He wears a sleeveless off-white tunic with dark grey shoulder panels, two dark red emblems on the chest and a thin maroon strap across it. A wide belt with a round buckle holds a long black skirt with an off-white front panel edged in maroon. His tall black boots have snarling face-shaped knee guards and clawed toe caps. His blades stay hidden in his forearms.

A large robot of blue and silver armour plates. His helmet has a dark faceplate with glowing light blue eye slits, and small blue lights glow on his chest, forearms, knees and feet. Upright fin-like blades with blue tips rise from both upper arms, and a dark segmented cable studded with blue lights runs from his head down his spine. His feet are armoured, with claw-like toes.

A tall robot with slim limbs in yellow and black plating. His smooth yellow helmet has black stripes and glowing green eye slits, and green lights glow at his neck, chest, stomach, forearms, knees and ankles. Grey panels cover his chest above a segmented black stomach. A black cable runs down his back to a small box at the base of his spine. His feet are yellow armoured plates with jointed toes.

A broad figure in a dark grey hood and face mask, showing only a faint orange glow at the eyes. He wears dark leathery armour with red trim and dark gloves. A gold belt with a large round green gem holds red side flaps and a long pointed grey front panel edged in red that hangs below his knees. A large gold disc sits on his upper back. His dark boots have green gems at the knees and gold straps.

A man of medium build in a battered brown fedora, his face and neck badly burned and scarred. He wears a worn red and dark green striped sweater with holes in it, dark jeans-like trousers and scuffed dark brown shoes. His right hand wears his glove with long blades on the fingers.

A slim, athletic woman with brown skin and long black hair in a ponytail tied with a gold band. A green mask covers her lower face. She wears a green halter one-piece with a deep plunging front, black criss-cross lacing over the chest and gold trim, with a long green front panel to her knees and gold patterned cords at the hips. Green and black bracers with gold bands cover her forearms, with black fingerless gloves and a gold armband. Her black over-the-knee heeled boots have green gem knee guards. She carries a short silver staff.

A very muscular man with dark skin, short dark hair and dog tags on a chain. He is shirtless, and both arms are grey metal bionics from the shoulders to the fists, with yellow details. A harness strap crosses his upper back. He wears a black belt with a silver buckle, dark green-black combat trousers with grey knee pads, and laced black boots.

A fit, tanned man with short brown hair and blue mirrored sunglasses. He is shirtless, with the word Johnny tattooed in script across his chest. His wrists and forearms are wrapped in white tape. A grey and white waistband carries a gold buckle that reads CAGE, over black trousers with blue padded shin guards. He wears grey, white and black sneakers.

A broad, muscular man with burn-scarred orange-red skin on his bare arms and long black hair. A dark metal mask with glowing red eye lenses and a red mouth slit covers his face, with a breathing tube down his chest and a glowing breathing pack on his back. Two thin metal hookswords cross his back. He wears a dark brown vest, a chest strap with glowing cyan panels, spiked metal forearm guards and black gloves. Grey wrappings and a grey cloth hang over tan trousers, with dark knee guards, black shin armour lit with cyan lines, and black boots with grey toes.

A muscular, bearded man with short dark hair. A silver metal plate covers one side of his face, with a glowing red eye. Tattoos cover his chest, arms and neck. He wears a black sleeveless top with red-trimmed lapels, open at the chest, and a mechanical strap with red lights across his chest and back. Grey metal forearm guards and fingerless gloves cover his arms. A black belt holds a black front apron with a red border. Dark cylinders banded in gold hang at his hips. He wears brown knee pads, grey caged shin guards and grey-white boots.

An athletic man with short dark hair and a red blindfold over his eyes, its long tails hanging down his back. He wears a grey high collar, a dark red ribbed top with a black pad on one shoulder, and a white sash across his chest printed with a red dragon. Black gloves have a cyan light at each wrist. His black studded armoured trousers have red trim and red knee caps, with a white serpent design on one shin, and plain grey boots. A sword in a red scabbard is slung diagonally across his back.

A slim, muscular woman with very long straight black hair down to her hips. A blue mask covers her lower face. She wears a blue halter top laced with black cord down the front, leaving her stomach bare, silver armbands and blue laced bracers. A long blue front panel hangs below her knees, leaving her hips and the sides of her thighs bare, and her back is largely bare. She wears blue thigh-high heeled boots with pointed tops. Her steel fans are not out.

A muscular man in his wide flat hat: a black crown, a red band and a sharp silver rim, its brim shading his face. He wears a black sleeveless top with frog-button fastenings and grey patterns, with a red symbol on the back, silver-edged armbands and black and silver bracers. A red sash with a silver buckle holds a long black front panel to his knees over baggy teal-grey trousers. He wears round dark knee guards, dark shin guards with red bands, and dark shoes trimmed in red.

A bare-chested, very muscular man with shoulder-length black hair and a red headband whose two tails hang down his back. He wears dark brown studded leather bracers and a wide dark red sash with a round gold dragon medallion, red sash strips hanging front and back. Black trousers end below his knees, and his lower legs are wrapped in grey cloth bound with red criss-cross straps, down to dark wrapped shoes.

A slim, muscular woman with long straight black hair. A magenta mask covers her lower face, hiding her teeth; only her eyes show. She wears a magenta one-piece with a deep open front, crossed black straps and gold trim, cut out at the back like a bikini with a gold ornament. Magenta gloves reach her elbows, with black lace at the tops of her thighs. She wears magenta thigh-high heeled boots with gold trim and gold knee ornaments. Her sais are not out.

A large, very muscular man with long black hair to mid-back and a black headband with a round turquoise stone. Dark red paint surrounds his eyes, and a pendant hangs on a necklace. He wears an open dark brown leather vest with red-patterned shoulders over his bare chest, a silver armband and dark red bracers edged in silver. A studded belt with a silver buckle holds dark grey jeans-like trousers, with a strap around one thigh holding a long dark object. He wears brown knee-high lace-up boots with turned-down cuffs.

A tall, broad, muscular figure dressed almost entirely in black and dark grey with a faint purple sheen, no skin showing. A close black hood and a ridged mask cover his head, with pale white-blue glowing eyes. Large rounded shoulder pads and a fitted chest plate with clasps down the centre cover his torso. He wears banded forearm guards and dark gloves, a wide belt with an ornate raised buckle and armoured flaps front and back, loose dark trousers, banded shin guards and dark round-toed boots.

A muscular, bare-chested sorcerer with chalk-white skin and a bald head, a red marking running back along his scalp and black shading around his eyes. Red tattoos cover his shoulders and forearms, with a large red circular emblem on his upper back. A dark green strap crosses his chest, holding a green pouch with something sticking up behind his shoulder. He wears black gloves, a dark belt with a round gold medallion with a green centre, dark olive trousers with a green front panel, spiked knee pads, and brown strapped leather boots to mid-shin.

A broad figure under a wide straw-coloured conical hat that hides his eyes, his lower face tan-skinned. He wears a white long-sleeved robe under a blue tabard trimmed in gold, with a dark high collar, gold toggles down the front and a round dark blue medallion on the chest. Silver shoulder pieces and silver forearm guards are trimmed in gold. A black sash holds blue panels front and back over the white robe skirt to his knees. Grey metal shin guards with gold edges cover his lower legs, and his feet are in white cloth shoes.

A muscular figure in a black hood and a purple mask over the lower face, with a gold band across the eyes. Dark tie strands hang from the hood down his back. He wears a black top with patterned purple chest panels and gold trim, spiked shoulder pieces and a gold ornament on his upper back. Gold-banded forearm guards and black fingerless gloves cover his arms. A pale rope belt with hanging cords holds brown leather side flaps and a patterned purple loincloth to his knees, over black trousers, dark purple gold-trimmed shin guards and dark wrapped footwear with gold toe caps.

A muscular figure with pale green scaly skin on his shoulders, arms and back. A dark green-black head covering and a mask with a pointed snout hide his face, and his eyes glow yellow-orange. He wears a black chest harness with crossed straps and a gold V emblem on the back, one dark shoulder plate, and bronze forearm guards with small silver spikes. His hands are bare and green. A dark belt with a gold buckle holds green trousers with a grey scaled front panel, brown patterned shin guards, and his feet are bare and green, with long claws.

A muscular figure with tan bare arms and dark bands around his upper arms. A grey-black hood with a ribbed texture and a gold mask cover his head, with two curved gold horn-like spikes rising behind it. He wears a sleeveless black and grey vest with gold panels down the chest, dark shoulder plates edged in gold, and black gauntlets trimmed in gold. His back is gold, with two long dark rods crossed in an X. A belt with an ornate buckle holds a jagged gold front flap over dark grey armoured trousers, black knee pads and black and gold patterned boots with gold toes.

A bulky robot clad entirely in red metal armour. A silver dome tops his head, over a red faceplate with two glowing cyan eyes. Large angular shoulder plates frame his chest, with a small glowing cyan light at its centre and a silver plate over his stomach. Glowing cyan strips run along his forearms. His back carries two large round silver housings with cyan centres and two smaller ones, with a dark cable down his spine. His thighs and shins are red, with dark grey knee plates and silver rounded toe tips.

A muscular man with tan bare arms, black slicked-back hair in a long ponytail and a dark goatee and moustache. He wears a sleeveless black vest edged in dark red, with large pointed gold shoulder pads, gold bars across his open chest and a green gem pendant, and a gold coiled dragon design over his back. Black armbands and black and gold bracers cover his arms. A gold belt with a green gem holds a long black mesh front panel with red trim over black trousers. His boots are ornate, stacked bands of gold, bronze and dark red.

A very tall, muscular Shokan woman with four arms and tan-brown skin, with a darker leopard-like spotted pattern across her back, shoulders and arms. She has a black mohawk with a long black ponytail and glowing orange eyes. She wears a red one-piece of two narrow straps over the chest, joined at a round metal buckle on a thin belt. Dark grey bracers with red studs and spikes cover all four forearms, and matching studded guards cover her shins and ankles. Her feet are bare.

A tall, fit woman with tan skin and very long two-toned hair, black with a white streak, falling to her lower back. She wears a black and purple one-piece with a deep plunging V and silver trim, and black fingerless gauntlets banded in silver. Long dark cloth panels hang from her hips front and back, her thighs are wrapped in open silver cage-like straps, and she wears tall black pointed boots to the knee with heels.

A slim, toned woman with tan skin and red hair in a long ponytail. A red hood-cowl covers her head and a red mask covers her lower face. She wears a red halter bra top with dark straps crossing her stomach, dark spiked shoulder pieces and black leather bracers. Two thin dark blades are crossed behind her lower back. A thin belt holds red loincloth panels front and back, with a dark band on one thigh. She wears black thigh-high tops over red leather knee boots with pointed toes.

A broad, muscular man with tan bare upper arms and long dark grey hair below his shoulders. A grey segmented metal mask covers his face below the eyes. He wears a sleeveless charcoal top with pointed grey shoulder pads and grey armour plates on the chest and back, long grey bracers, and a wide dark belt with a buckle. Dark baggy trousers have a grey chain-mail panel hanging to a point at the front. Grey armour covers his knees and shins, and his dark footwear has grey toe caps.

A fit woman of average height with tan skin and dark blonde hair in a long ponytail. She wears a low-cut dark green-black sleeveless vest that bares her stomach, with dog tags on a chain and a small badge. Dark bands circle her upper arms, with black fingerless gloves. A low-slung belt holds dark green-black trousers with straps on one thigh, dark knee pads, and tall black lace-up combat boots.

A broad, heavy-set man with light skin, short reddish-brown hair and a dark blue police cap. He wears a fitted blue short-sleeved shirt with dark shoulder panels and a badge on a chain, under a black shoulder harness with holsters at both hips. Dark wrist bands and black fingerless gloves cover his hands. Two black batons are crossed on his back. He wears a black belt, black cargo trousers with knee pads, and black boots.

A broad, muscular man with tan bare upper arms. A dark hood covers his head and a light blue metal mask covers his lower face. He wears a sleeveless blue tunic crossed over the chest with dark trim, a wide silver patterned belt, dark guards on his upper arms and wrapped grey and blue bracers. A blue front panel hangs between dark side panels, ending in a silver piece. His shins are wrapped in grey and blue, and his feet wear pale silver patterned wrappings.

A bald, very muscular warrior with ash-white skin and a scowl. A red tattoo stripe runs over his scalp and down one side of his face, a scar crosses his brow and eye on the other side, and he has a black goatee. A broad red tattoo stripe crosses his chest diagonally from the shoulder. The Blades of Chaos hang on chains from his forearms, and a gold-trimmed fleece hangs behind his shoulder. Below the waist he wears a short dark battle skirt and sandals laced up his calves.
